title.narrative: ICRC operations by the Gulf Cooperation Council (regional) Delegation(2024 Unaudited)

description.narrative: The ICRC’s Kuwait City delegation promotes the incorporation of international humanitarian law into national legislation and conducts military training in countries of the Gulf Cooperation Council. It also protects detainees and handles humanitarian matters arising from the 1990-1991 Gulf War.
